releaseNotes: Flow Client v1.4.6: Complete Settings overhaul! Removed redundant mods/branding toggles; added modern custom RAM slider with quick presets and system RAM warning; full Minecraft display & resolution management (Fullscreen toggle, FHD/HD+/HD/2K presets and custom width/height); Discord RPC; streamlined 5-category sidebar matching Flow aesthetic; quick-access Game Folders hub; and 1-click Storage & Disk Cleanup.
